$comment: Dialed Moods design tokens. Read this before writing any layout, prompt, or CSS. The Social Elixir launch look is a DARK surface and is not the brand's older white-studio product photography — see `surfaces`, they are not interchangeable.

sources.title: Social Elixir launch set — approved creative
Dialed Seltzer Kava can renders (supplied by client)
MARKETING ROAD MAP - Social Elixir.csv (client sheet)

tagline: Your full potential with Herbal Bio-hacking.

disclosures.$comment: Exact strings. On the Social Elixir set the age gate is rendered by the image model and then VERIFIED by eye on every render — see FORMATS.md section 5. Anything longer should be composed deterministically instead.
disclosures.rule: The age gate is mandatory on every consumer-facing Social Elixir asset and must be legible in the final pixels, not merely present in the prompt.

fdaSupplement.note: Dialed Moods cans are labelled DIETARY SUPPLEMENT. Whether the FDA structure/function disclaimer must appear on-graphic or may live in the caption is an OPEN question for the client's reviewer. Do not silently decide it.

surfaces.$comment: Keep surfaces separate. Dialed Moods has two live looks and mixing them is the fastest way to make a creative stop reading as the brand.

launchDark.$comment: The APPROVED Social Elixir launch look. Dark, cinematic, editorial — like a high-end spirits campaign. This is the surface for the 2026 launch social set.
launchDark.groundNote: Near-black, always a gradient rather than a flat fill. The can sits in a pool of coloured light that dissolves into it with no detectable edge.
launchDark.accentNote: Gold. The ONLY accent. One accent colour per graphic — a second competing colour breaks the look.

goldMetal.$comment: Gold is rendered as brushed metal, never flat fill. Vertical gradient, top to bottom.

flavourLight.$comment: The bloom behind the can is tinted per flavour. Everything else stays identical.

whiteStudio.$comment: The brand's older look — magazine-grade packshots on flat white/cream. Still valid for product photography and can-reveal animation. DO NOT mix it with launchDark in one set.

logo.$comment: Italic chrome 'DIALED' wordmark with a heavy gold outline, and a small 'MOODS' at its lower right. It is an ARTWORK FILE — pass it as a reference image, never describe it and hope.
logo.placement: Small, top-left corner, on every piece in the launch set.
rules: Never re-letter, restyle or re-draw the wordmark.
A thin gold outline version is WRONG — the outline is heavy and the face is chrome.
Never enlarge it into a background watermark.

typography.$comment: The approved launch set is generated by an image model, so the rules below are PROMPT rules. The families are a documented STAND-IN, not a verified brand font — see `familiesStatus`.

familiesStatus.note: Dialed Moods' real typeface has NOT been confirmed with the client. The approved renders were produced from the prompt description 'heavy modern geometric sans, tight tracking, sentence case' — no font file was ever specified. Archivo and Inter are chosen here because they are the closest Google Fonts match to the approved renders and because `brandkit fonts` requires a bundleable family. Treat them as a fallback for any future HTML/CSS surface, NOT as brand truth. Confirm the real family with the client before setting type deterministically.
familiesStatus.action: ASK THE CLIENT for the brand typeface, then replace this block.

body.name: Inter
body.role: body copy and small print — stand-in, see familiesStatus

rules: Headline: heavy modern geometric sans, tight tracking, SENTENCE CASE. Never all-caps headlines.
The final phrase of a headline is set in brushed-metal gold; the rest is white. One gold phrase per graphic.
Eyebrow: small, gold, letterspaced caps, sitting on a thin gold rule that runs off the frame edge.
Body copy: white, one or two short lines maximum.
Type NEVER overlaps the can and always keeps a generous left margin.
NO ghosted, watermark, oversized or repeated background lettering. This was tried and explicitly rejected.

devices.$comment: The signature treatments that make the launch look itself. Described in full as a literal prompt block in hero-prompts.json under `typeDepth`.
devices.typeInScene: Type is lit by the same key light as the can, casts a real shadow, and reflects in the glossy floor. It is never a flat sticker layer pasted on top.
devices.atmosphereOnly: The layer behind the can is smoke and light only — never lettering, and never a hard-edged disc, halo, ring or spotlight cut-out.
devices.floorReflection: The can and the type both reflect in a dark glossy floor, dimmer and blurred, fading out.
devices.bokehInFront: A few soft out-of-focus motes drift IN FRONT of the type so atmosphere passes over it.

assets.$comment: Committed artwork, present on a fresh clone. Repository-relative paths only.
assets.styleMasterNote: The approved launch creative. Pass `styleMasterRef` (the 1400px copy) as a reference image on every new piece so the set cannot drift. The full-size file is the archival original.
assets.cansNote: Filenames read 'Artic' — the can artwork itself correctly reads 'ARCTIC BLUE'. Do not 'fix' the filenames; scripts reference them.

prohibited: Ghosted / oversized / watermark background lettering behind the can — tried on the launch set and explicitly rejected.
Compositing: placing a supplied can render into an HTML/CSS layout and screenshotting it — rejected as 'a flyer made on Canva'.
Scaling the supplied can render up to fill a frame — reads soft and low-res against generated type.
A hard-edged glow disc, halo or spotlight circle behind the can, or a bright straight horizon streak across the floor.
A second accent colour competing with the gold.
Naming a competitor (New Brew, Leilo, Mitra9) — that converts the creative into a comparative claim.
Star ratings, review counts or customer counts — no reviews exist yet.
The word 'buzz' in any Social Elixir copy — see selling-points.json.
